name: keep lands the card in project order
keep puts a card above a later one
top puts the card first in the project
after a card in the target column
after a card in another column follows project order
top within the same column reorders it
no option adds the No Status column
leaving No Status empty removes the column
a move already applied changes nothing
another field keeps the column and moves the position
after the next card in the same column moves the card down
